FIGHT CAMP – PHASE 1 (Coach Dan)
Weeks 1-3 (repeat)

MONDAY – Strength
Focus: brace hard, own every rep.
Trap bar deadlift 4x5 @ 140kg, rest 2-3 min. Cue: drive through the floor. Stop if lower back pain.
Bulgarian split squat 3x8 each side, RPE 7
Landmine press 3 x 6-8 (last set to failure)
Copenhagen plank 3 x 30s

WEDNESDAY – Pads
6 x 3 min rounds, 1 min rest. Finish every combo on the jab. 16oz gloves.
Shadow boxing 3 rounds – head movement

Day 3 – Roadwork
5 km easy run, zone 2
Hill sprints AMRAP 10 min

SATURDAY – Sparring
Hard sparring 6 x 3 min
Nutrition: hit 180g protein daily
Sauna 2x a week if cutting
